title: Tourist Season, 2009 · worse
logline: The day after Gully says the strip's Gully is better looking: Wood on the stool drawing him worse — the nose, the ears — and Gully looking over the counter and asking what that is. A portrait, Wood says. Gully says it's better looking than yesterday's. The strip keeps it.

panels.composition: Gully's. WOOD on the stool drawing on the pad, glancing up at GULLY with intent. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man on a stool drawing on a pad and glancing up pointedly at a stocky man behind a counter

panels.composition: The pad: Gully, the nose bigger, the ears out, the apron the same.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a pad showing a caricature of a stocky man with an exaggerated nose and ears in a fisherman's apron
brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man in an apron leaning across a counter to look at a pad

panels.composition: WOOD turning it so he can see. GULLY's face.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man turning a pad to show a caricature to a stocky man whose expression is unbothered

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; Sundays the point

notes: Worse for a week. Better looking than yesterday's.
